About Us

Brewed for you. Made with heart.

At Arched Co, we believe great coffee brings people together and creates moments that matter.

Founded in Medan, Arched Co began with a simple belief: great coffee, warm hospitality, and handmade bakery treats can make everyday moments feel special.
